description: This is a C source file implementing a driver for the Würth Elektronik WSEN HIDS sensor in the Zephyr RTOS. It includes functions for initializing the sensor, fetching samples, setting output data rates, and handling sensor attributes, along with device instantiation macros.

methods.name: hids_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches raw sensor data and converts humidity and temperature values.

methods.name: hids_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current humidity or temperature as sensor_value.

methods.name: hids_odr_set
methods.description: Sets the output data rate based on predefined supported values.

methods.name: hids_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes, primarily sampling frequency.

methods.name: hids_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, configures interface, checks device ID, and sets default parameters.
